941-mcgill-medical-students-society-inc: All registered medical students; Lady Meredith Annex, 3706 Peel St. It represents students to the Faculty, government and public, links them through FMEQ and CFMS, pushes for new ways of learning, runs sports and social events, supports clubs and outreach, holds at least one general assembly a year, and publishes the weekly newsletter The Murmur. Members sit on committees including the M.D.,C.M. Program and Admissions Committees.
941-l-association-des-etudiant-e-s-en-me: Regroupe tous les étudiants en médecine et les représente auprès de la Faculté, du gouvernement et du public. Liens avec la FMEQ et la FEMC, activités sportives et sociales, appui aux clubs et aux projets communautaires, au moins une assemblée générale par an, et l'hebdomadaire The Murmur. Elle siège à plusieurs comités de la Faculté.
941-osler-society: Founded in 1921 in memory of Sir William Osler, McGill's celebrated graduate and professor. Guest lectures, papers on humanities and social sciences in medicine, and philanthropy, to round out future physicians. The fall Osler Lecture is followed by a formal Osler Banquet.
942-mcgill-journal-of-medicine: Since May 1994: a student-produced, peer-reviewed, open-access journal, twice a year, publishing student research, case reports, reviews and essays from around the world. The only student-run journal limited to original student research.
942-other-medical-societies-and-clubs: Listed on the McGill Journal of Medicine site.

McGill University Health Centre (MUHC): merged teaching hospitals giving advanced bilingual adult and pediatric care. Yearly: 519,000+ ambulatory visits, 32,600+ inpatients, 29,600+ surgeries, 2,800+ births. Sites: Glen (1001 Decarie Blvd.: Children's, Royal Victoria, Chest Institute, Cedars Cancer Centre); Montreal General (1650 Cedar Ave.); The Neuro (3801 University St.); Lachine Hospital (650 16th Ave.); CHSLD Camille-Lefebvre (637, 13e Ave.); Reproductive Centre (888 de Maisonneuve E., Suite 200); Adult Ophthalmology Clinic (5252 de Maisonneuve W.).

17,000+ people across seven missions: Medicine, Surgery, Neurosciences, Mental Health, Women's Health, Cancer Care, Children's. In 2024–2025: 3,793 nursing and related staff, 2,098 other health professionals, 3,493 research members, 1,414 physicians, 150 pharmacists, 339 managers, 2,237 office staff, 2,531 paratechnical and trades, 863 volunteers. Every physician is a McGill professor. It trains 5,200+ a year: 1,000+ residents, 2,500 nursing, 980 medical and 700 others.

Research Institute of the MUHC: 744 researchers, 1,490+ trainees and 1,476 staff, at Glen and the General, partly FRQS funded; rimuhc.ca. The MUHC is also the server lab for Montreal's OPTILAB cluster.

Jewish General Hospital (CIUSSS West-Central, 3755 Côte Ste-Catherine Rd.): since 1934, 637 beds. Yearly 22,000+ admissions, about 592,000 outpatient and 92,000+ emergency visits, 3,600+ births, 12,000+ surgeries. Known for oncology (Segal Cancer Centre), cardiology, neonatology, orthopedics, family medicine, aging and emergency. A Quebec centre for high-risk obstetrics and breast referral, and an early COVID-19 hospital. About 850 doctors and 300+ residents. Hosts McGill's Wainberg Centre for Viral Diseases and translational cancer, head and neck, and menopause programs. Its Lady Davis Institute leads in cancer, aging, epidemiology, nursing, cardiovascular, genetics and more.

St. Mary's Hospital Center (CIUSSS West Island, 3830 Lacombe Ave.): 271 adult beds, university-affiliated. In 2024–2025, 3,551+ births; first Montreal hospital with WHO Baby Friendly recognition. Family medicine, dialysis, oncology, geriatrics, imaging. Yearly 104,509+ clinic visits, 7,113 day surgeries, 14,489+ admissions. Its Research Centre covers cancer, surgery, older adults and primary care.

Douglas Mental Health University Institute (CIUSSS West Island, 6875 LaSalle Blvd.): founded in 1881, WHO-affiliated, for child, adult and geriatric care with a focus on rehabilitation and community. 134,589+ interventions yearly. One of Canada's largest mental health research centres, with 64 scientists and 450+ students in 2024–2025, and McGill centres on schizophrenia, aging and suicide, plus a PAHO/WHO Collaborating Centre.
944-institutions-affiliated-with-mcgill-: Since Quebec's 2015 reform, hospitals are grouped in CIUSSS or CISSS, and affiliation contracts are with these. 945-facilities-for-human-nutrition: Clinical Nutrition Research Unit, Macdonald Campus, since 1995: a 5,000 sq. ft. building for in-patient studies with controlled diets, unique in Canada. Body composition and sample tools, an exercise area, research kitchen and dining observation room, sensory food lab, data lab, and Canada's first food pharmacy. Self-funded; outside researchers contact the Director of Human Nutrition.
